summary.intent: Implement Task K for Callisto: make `callisto init` translate a Changesets v2/v3 `.changeset/config.json` into `callisto.toml` (fixed groups, baseBranch workflow filter, access refusal, warnings for ignored keys), following the lead's owner decisions and the repo's gate/PR process.
summary.outcome: Implemented the translation in a new `init/changesets.rs` module with CLI wiring, E342 error, docs, spec criteria, a changeset and tests using real v2/v3 configs. pre-push, lint and doc-check passed and a signed commit was made; `just test` was rerun after failures that were not resolved in the transcript, and mutants, reviewer subagent, merge of origin/main, push, trail/PR and lead report were not done.

repo: Init logic is split: graph crate `commands/init.rs` (facts, answers, render_config) and CLI crate `commands/init.rs` (orchestration, prompts, workflow building); new init submodule `init/changesets.rs` with its own `changesets/tests.rs`.

`InitAnswers` and `InitPackage` literals are constructed in several places (graph tests, CLI init.rs and CLI tests), so adding a field like `fixed_groups` or `npm_access` requires migrating every sibling call site.
Callisto publishes scoped npm packages without `publishConfig.access` as public, determined by `npm_default_access` in `commands/registry_argv.rs`; `PublishTarget::Npm` carries an `access` option.

New error codes need entries in `crates/callisto-cli/src/error.rs` (including the exit-code match arm), `docs/errors.md`, and a criterion in `docs/specs/cli.json`; E342 was allocated with lead approval.

Changeset files are created via `cargo run -p callisto-cli -- add ...` which generates a random-named file whose body then must be edited; multiline summaries via shell args did not work reliably, so a placeholder was used and the file edited.
Glob matching for fixed patterns uses `globset::GlobBuilder` with `literal_separator(true)` so `*` does not cross the `@scope/` separator, matching Changesets behavior.
Test helpers in graph `init/tests.rs` (repo, detect_in, parse, ORIGIN, INDEPENDENT) needed `pub(in crate::commands::init)` visibility to be shared with the new child test module.
Worktree-based work: git calls needed `/usr/bin/git` and absolute paths in some shell invocations; macOS `sed -i` needs an empty `''` backup suffix.

code.finding: New module holding `Migration`, `FixedGroup`, `migrate`, `base_branch`, `apply_fixed_groups`, `base_branch_unused`; replaces the old `changesets_config_diagnostics` table/function that lived in init.rs.

Refuses with `CliError::InitChangesetsAccess` before prompting when `public_scoped` is non-empty and neither --yes nor --dry-run; `build_workflow` now takes an optional base branch that overrides `scaffold::default_branch` using the new `DefaultBranchSource::ChangesetsBaseBranch`.
`render_config` now builds `[[fixed-group]]` from either the `all` group (Versioning::Fixed) or `answers.fixed_groups` (Independent); groups with no members are skipped.

friction: Repeated greps were needed to find types (`GroupName`, `BranchName`) and the existing diagnostics before writing the first test.
Shell invocations of `git` and cargo with multiline `--summary` strings failed or had to be retried; the changeset body was finally edited by hand.
`sed -i` without the macOS empty suffix failed once and had to be rerun.
`just pre-push` failed once on tests referencing the old `INDEPENDENT`/`apply_fixed_groups` usage and needed a test helper (`apply`) to fix.
`just test` was run three times with failures; the transcript does not show the failures being resolved before the commit.
open_items: Run `cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff` on the Rust diff and record zero missed/argued equivalents in the PR body.
Run `just ci` (not yet run) and confirm `just test` passes cleanly.
Run one fresh Opus reviewer subagent on the diff and apply valid findings.

Merge latest origin/main before pushing, re-run gates if it moved, push with `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>`, verify with `git ls-remote`, link trail #458 and open PR via `entire trail ci-pr`.
Handle any Entire findings and report the rest to the lead; send the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) a final report with PR number, sha, gates run and unverified items.
Confirm the commit is signed (the `%G?` check output was not shown) and has no session trailer.
